headline: COMET DRIFT HD proves its phone path — and red main gets fixed on the way
lede: Phones have no WebGPU; the game's auto-fallback to three's WebGL backend had never been exercised unpinned, and WebGPU pixels were only eyeballed on screenshots. #987 pins both paths with computed gates, and the merge's static failure uncovered (and fixed) a red main.

notes.text: Phone auto-fallback pinned headlessly (#987/#990): navigator.gpu killed before page scripts on a 390x844 touch page — the fallback engages unpinned, the device-loss refuge is armed, tap-to-start races, and a provoked mid-race GPU loss self-heals and repaints without reload.

WebGPU pixels are now proven by the numbers: compositor PNG luma stats + frame-to-frame motion replace eyeballed screenshots; three's WebGLBackend ignores preserveDrawingBuffer, so real dusk pixels are sampled in-frame — the only oracle the phone path has.

Red main fixed (#991): jonqcheck assumed every flagship always has an open honest-gap; SSX honestly shipped out of its list and 7 static gates went red on every PR. The canary now distinguishes a broken parse from a finished list.
Mutant demanded: faking a webgpu classification turns 9 fallback gates red — honest naming, armed refuge, live probe and the heal are all load-bearing now.
